name: Watermark
description: A benchmark for evaluating underwater acoustic modem performance under realistic marine conditions.
evaluation_method: bit_error_rate / throughput / packet_delivery_ratio (empirical communication performance metrics)
typical_sota_score: unknown (highly variable by environment and modem)
reputation: Specialized benchmark in underwater acoustics with modest adoption among marine-communication and modem-evaluation researchers.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; results are strongly environment-, hardware-, and deployment-dependent (sea state, range, noise); datasets are often small and real-world, making reproducibility and generalization challenging.
